shortDescription: Generate a certificate using HashiCorp Vault PKI backend

options.name: alt_names
options.description: A comma-separated list of Subject Alternative Names (SANs) for the certificate.

options.name: common_name
options.description: The common name (CN) for the certificate.

options.name: engine_mount_point
options.description: The mount point of the PKI secrets engine in Vault.

options.name: ip_sans
options.description: A comma-separated list of IP SANs for the certificate.

options.name: on_target
options.description: Whether to run the task on the target host.

options.name: role_name
options.description: The role name in the PKI backend that defines permissions and policies.

options.name: token
options.description: The Vault token to authenticate with the PKI backend.

options.name: ttl
options.description: The time-to-live (TTL) duration for the certificate. Overrides role-defined TTL if specified.

options.name: vault_addr
options.description: The Vault server's address. Passed as the URL to the Vault API.
